turns.text: Good to see you again. Where would you like to start today?
I am not sure where to begin, there are so many things going round in my head at the moment.
Take your time.
We went to a baby swimming class and Oliver loved the water.
Take your time.
I made myself a cup of tea this morning and just stood by the window for a while. I do not know, it is hard to explain.
Take your time.
I wrote a few notes before coming here, but now I cannot remember half of what I wanted to say.
I see. Can you say a bit more?
I still feel guilty about the formula, although Oliver is growing well.
Mm-hm. Go on.
It has been a grey week, and the weather does not help my mood much, to be honest. I do not know, it is hard to explain.
What happened next?
Some days are better than others, and I try to remind myself of that when things get heavy.
Mm-hm. Go on.
My first CBT session was on Monday and the therapist, Rachel, gave me a worry diary.
What happened next?
The journey here took a while, but at least I had time to gather my thoughts. I think so, yes.
Mm-hm. Go on.
I tell Tom about the scary thoughts now, he says it makes him feel closer to me.
What went through your mind then?
It is strange to sit here and say all of this out loud, but it does help a little. I think so, yes.
We are nearly out of time. Is there anything you want to add?
No, I think that is everything. Thank you.
